Ivy: Quick postmortem follow-up: we've split the fix into three remediation cards. Need owners, concrete ETAs, and acceptance criteria so we can track and close.
Ben: I'll take REDX-721 (kv-cache eviction tuning). Will add perf plan + acceptance criteria today.
Carla: Thx Ben. Please include a monthly regression job (the recurring spike on the 1st). Also link the dashboard panels.
Ben: Added monthly smoke job + dashboard link. Acceptance: p95 < 90ms on canary, sustained hit-rate >= 92%. ETA Wed-2024-06-12.
Samir: I'll own REDX-734 (failover automation & runbook). Creating Jira now.
Samir: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDX-734  stub created, ETA 4 business days. Will include staged dry-run checklist.
Diego: REDX-748 (capacity alert + autoscale thresholds) needs eng-infra changes. Eng-infra will be R, I'll be A for verification. Diego (eng-infra) to post ETA tomorrow.
Ivy: Proposed RACI: REDX-721 R=Ben A=Carla C=SRE I=Oncall; REDX-734 R=Samir A=Ivy C=Platform I=PMs; REDX-748 R=Eng-Infra A=Diego C=Platform I=Customers. Any objections?
Carla: Looks good. Tag tickets with "postmortem-action" and add to remediation board so compliance can see them.
incident-bot: Reminder: owners must add due dates and acceptance criteria in Jira within 48h.
Ben: REDX-721 updated with perf artifacts, test harness, and recurrence note. Tagged and added to remediation board.
Samir: REDX-734 runbook draft uploaded, rollback steps included, added canary checklist. ETA Mon-2024-06-17.
Diego: Eng-infra confirmed REDX-748 owner (Luis). Luis will post ETA by EOD tomorrow.
Ivy: I'll run weekly remediation syncs until these close, then switch to monthly audits for 3 months. I'll send calendar invites and a short agenda.
Carla: Also: add a short "recurrence summary" to each ticket so future owners know the 1st-of-month pattern.
Ben: Done  added recurrence summary and linked incident timeline.
Ivy: Thanks all. If anyone needs a handoff for the rollout or dry-run, ping me and I'll pair. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled for 2024-06-15 to check progress on REDX-721/734/748.
